claims: Kenyan runner John Korir set a new men's course record of 2:01:52 at the 2026 Boston Marathon.
John Korir's 2:01:52 surpassed the 15-year-old record of 2:03:02 set by Geoffrey Mutai in 2011.
Sharon Lokedi of Kenya won the 2026 women's division in 2:18:51.
Marcel Hug holds the men's wheelchair record of 1:16:06 set in 2024.
John Korir (KEN) holds the men's open record of 2:01:52 set in 2026.
Hellen Obiri (KEN) holds the women's open record of 2:19:59 set in 2024.
Marcel Hug (SUI) holds the men's wheelchair record of 1:16:06 set in 2024.
Manuela Schär (SUI) holds the women's wheelchair record of 1:28:17 set in 2017.
According to early reports, Sharon Lokedi ran 2:18:51 at the 2026 Boston Marathon.
John Korir's 2026 victory was immediately recognized as a new course record.
John Korir's course record shaved over a minute off the previous mark
